Quick update on the health front — I’ve tested positive for COVID. Grateful to be experiencing only mild symptoms thanks to the vaccine & booster.

Will be working remotely — for all the Rules Committee nerds, remember we’ve got a hearing at 2 pm (tune in!)

Also, get vaccinated!

With so many of our nation's veterans struggling with PTSD, we're working to ensure the VA is providing comprehensive treatment and compensation, so they can access the care they need. Grateful to see my bill considered in @VetAffairsDems this week https://t.co/F6oGuXHHNo

#Colorado will receive a first of its kind grant of $3.9 million to provide funding for nutrition security in underserved communities. Food banks, food pantries and schools across the state can apply. Learn more ⬇️⬇️⬇️

https://t.co/U6AjTqrEZC

🌱Don’t miss out on your chance to support nutrition education, gardening experiences and farm-to-school programs for students this week on May 6th, 7th, & 14th!

https://t.co/JRni6JzCkK

Next up was the State and Local Government Cybersecurity Act, which fosters cybersecurity coordination between state and local entities to secure taxpayer’s data privacy – after recent cyber-attacks on hospitals & schools in Colorado, this program is more important than ever. https://t.co/V3pkWfeKZI

Last week, the House passed the #RestoringHope for Mental Health and Well-Being Act — a bill to expand suicide prevention services and mental health treatment. 

It's long past time to ensure folks can access the mental health care they need. https://t.co/BdWVBIRqRD

Right now federal first responders are not eligible to receive retirement benefits unless they continue to work until age 57. To rectify that, Congress passed the First Responder Fair RETIRE Act – to ensure fair treatment for emergency workers! 🚒

In Colorado, reproductive freedoms will remain protected. Thank you @GovofCO for your leadership.👏🏽 
https://t.co/Vhy1TEDFls

🚨GREAT NEWS — our VA Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder Processing Claims Improvement Act was just successfully added to the #NDAA! An important step forward in improving treatment & compensation for our veterans. 

On to the Senate! 

https://t.co/j08hOESvet

Earlier this week, I joined @ProtectOurCare & @RepJasonCrow to discuss the impact the #InflationReductionAct will have on healthcare accessibility, including lowering prescription drug costs & health insurance premiums! 

Watch at https://t.co/48rmQldAWI https://t.co/LXuQRLcEZd

Good news! CO insurance companies have agreed to extend additional living expenses (ALE) coverage for individuals impacted by the Marshall Fire. 
 
If you or someone you know was impacted, learn more here: https://t.co/cwah5ALB84

To make health care more affordable, Democrats are lowering prescription drug costs, cutting health insurance premiums, capping out-of-pocket drug costs for seniors, and giving Medicare the power to negotiate lower prices.

#SOTUAddress

As a longtime supporter of the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program, I will always fight to #DefendSNAP.
 
We should be protecting hardworking everyday Americans, not cutting nutrition support for families in need.
Proud to lead the introduction of the Save Children's Coverage Act in the House, a critical bill to expand & preserve access to health care coverage for America's kids! https://t.co/b3WYi9PJUl

Every American should have high-quality, affordable health care. That’s why @HouseDemocrats have expanded tax credits to help lower health insurance premiums for millions of Americans. https://t.co/xu5OtGwzeo

For many Americans, specialized hearing devices are critical for communicating. It is unconscionable that insurance companies continue to deny coverage for these essential devices—we intend to stop them.

Today, I reintroduced Ally’s Act a bill named after my 13 yo constituent. https://t.co/Ywf32HLE5N

Stopped by the Loveland Fire Rescue Authority’s new training grounds. Thanks to federal community project funding we secured last year, this site will soon be a health & wellness center for firefighters across Northern Colorado! https://t.co/jMWux3qYw0

In 2019, a 10 year-old constituent of mine wrote to our office explaining the need for affordable specialized hearing devices. Since then, we’ve worked to enact insurance reforms to ensure coverage of these essential devices

Honored to host Ally’s mom @EarCommunityOrg this week! https://t.co/EnR5b0xe54

Many thanks to the more than 150 folks who joined our senior town-halls yesterday in #Boulder and #Louisville! We’ve worked hard to make life better for American seniors, including by capping insulin costs at $35/month for Medicare recipients. 
 
More to come! https://t.co/ciFxuzbMEt

House Democrats are delivering on our promise to lower the cost of prescription drugs. @POTUS ann the first 10 drugs selected for Medicare Price Negotiation – an IRA provision that enables Medicare to negotiate lower costs for seniors & more

Over 9 million Americans will benefit

Nearly 2 years after the devastating Marshall Fire, many #Colorado families still need assistance during the rebuilding process.
 
Last week, I led an effort calling on insurance companies to extend critical coverage for our communities. https://t.co/zgFMvr1aL2

Our mountain communities face distinct challenges when accessing critical broadband services.

I wrote to the @FCC requesting they update current broadband coverage maps & help us ensure improved access to high-speed internet for households across Colorado.🏔️ https://t.co/gAFN6jODQH

Yesterday I hosted a roundtable with health care workers & medical professionals from across #Colorado to discuss our efforts to make universal healthcare and #MedicareForAll a reality. https://t.co/L95HWUiHnO

Grateful for the opportunity to visit with the hard-working volunteers at the Lyons Emergency and Assistance Fund. Thanks to federal funding we secured, LEAF is expanding their food pantry & mental wellness programs, helping to address pressing needs in our community! https://t.co/rMplAC5SOL

2023 Rewind ⏪ Constituent Success Stories!  

Reminder: Our office is here to provide support with federal agencies, including help with Social Security and Medicare benefits, veterans’ benefits, housing matters, IRS issues, and much more. https://t.co/uAqOxy1FJB
